purpose: Test a recurrent SIR-style additive transmission hazard on fully reconstructed native displayed order books, with a held-out prediction benchmark.
market_control: SPY on XNAS.ITCH, completed BBO-1s observations
replay: Every requested native MBO event from 00:00 through 20:00 UTC; preserve every displayed resting order at every price level. Score 13:30–20:00 UTC, with 30-second initial warmup.
initialization: Require authoritative clear/reset before usable state. Accept synthetic snapshot clears, real clears, and an explicitly audited first legacy synthetic R with BAD_TS_RECV, zero sequence/order/size and undefined price under a verified midnight-start request. Its timestamp is not treated as a market event. Later generic bad-clock clears do not restore trust.
order_semantics: A adds, M sets absolute resting size/price (including zero to remove a completed order), C decrements quantity, R clears. T/F are informational and do not themselves reduce resting size. Total add flow includes A and positive M size changes; total removed flow includes C and negative M size changes. Same-size M repricing moves an order without changing total resting shares. Fill-linked C/M decrements are execution removals; other decrements are cancellations.
atomic_state: Inspect book after F_LAST. Predictor data must have ts_recv strictly before anchor. A partially completed atomic event is unavailable.
validation: Compare reconstructed top-ten prices, sizes and order counts with independent native MBP-10 records for 14:00–14:05 UTC on every venue/day. Report missing matches and semantic errors; do not silently drop a venue or date. Fix reconstruction errors before fitting.
quiet_books: An initialized healthy continuous MBO book persists when unchanged. No blanket one-second quote-update age cutoff is used. Book age is a predictor. Quality barriers, resets and unavailable states are explicit.
clock: ts_recv nanoseconds, with a fixed 2ms source lead and a 30-second past-only shifted-source control. Transport latency can affect inferred links.
shock_definition: Absolute nonzero midpoint changes between valid completed MBO states in one healthy segment during regular trading. Per-venue threshold=max(0.005 USD, training 75th percentile). No prior quote-freshness gap cutoff is imposed on a continuously observed reconstructed book.

susceptible_infected_refractory.accepted_events: Only shocks arriving while susceptible create infections. Ignore shocks during I/R. States reset on a book reset/barrier and at each day boundary. Eligibility requires target susceptible strictly before anchor.

hazard: lambda_i(t)=exp(a_i+x_i(t)'w_i)+sum(j!=i) beta_ji I_j(t-2ms), beta_ji>=0; p_i(t)=1-exp(-0.01*lambda_i(t)). Fixed-duration recurrent SIRS-inspired process; recovery/immunity durations are not fitted.
logistic_comparator: Refit the previous logistic network family on exactly the new accepted-infection labels, susceptible cohort and MBO/common controls, adding own and other-venue past infection counts over 10/100/1000ms. Own one-second infection history is already a shared control and appears only once. Fixed C=1, training-only scaling.
implementation_clarifications_before_fit: Independent depth validation exposed a native Cboe F followed by absolute M-to-zero execution pattern. The adapter now removes that order exactly once and counts C/M quantity decrements consistently; raw offending messages and old failed replay checkpoints remain preserved.
Own one-second infection history occurs in both the shared controls and legacy feature family; the logistic comparator includes that semantic column once to preserve its intended fixed L2 penalty.
The shifted-source quality mask independently requires observed valid state at the past evaluation time. This requirement applies to all four models.
paired_cohort: Same target/day/time observations for every model. All required source books initialized and healthy; previous one second of features within the same healthy segment, observed target outcome and valid completed market control. Thirty-second warmup and independently valid past source states at t-30002ms permit the past-shifted control without wrapping, future data or invented susceptible states.
primary_comparison: sirs_network versus independent_mbo_hazard, paired pooled log loss; lower is better.

inference.unit: whole trading date across all venues

support: All intended dates and venues complete, reconstruction audit passes, models converge, positive pooled primary gain and positive lower paired five-session-block gain interval. Secondary comparisons and shift control remain visible even if unfavorable.
limitations: Unsigned shock-risk propagation, not signed price-level impact. Full displayed MBO does not reveal hidden resting orders or maker identities. Beta rates are conditional predictive associations; no causal contagion, epidemiological R0 or trading profit is inferred.
